import * as THREE from 'three';
import {buildDuixiuNaturalFront} from './DuixiuNaturalFront.js';
import {buildDuixiuBaseUnion} from './DuixiuBaseUnion.js';
import {faceTriplanarUV} from './shapes.js';
import {createTriangleTemplate,triangleInstance} from '../../utils/TriangleSupport.js';
const f=Math.fround,BASE=.05;
function outside(box,r){const l=Math.max(box.min.x,r.min.x),h=Math.min(box.max.x,r.max.x),a=Math.max(box.min.z,r.min.z),b=Math.min(box.max.z,r.max.z);if(l>=h||a>=b)return[box];return[[box.min.x,l,box.min.z,box.max.z],[h,box.max.x,box.min.z,box.max.z],[l,h,box.min.z,a],[l,h,b,box.max.z]].filter(([x0,x1,z0,z1])=>x1-x0>1e-10&&z1-z0>1e-10).map(([x0,x1,z0,z1])=>new THREE.Box3(new THREE.Vector3(x0,box.min.y,z0),new THREE.Vector3(x1,box.max.y,z1)));}
function boxGeometry(b){const a=b.min,c=b.max,p=[[a.x,a.y,a.z],[c.x,a.y,a.z],[c.x,c.y,a.z],[a.x,c.y,a.z],[a.x,a.y,c.z],[c.x,a.y,c.z],[c.x,c.y,c.z],[a.x,c.y,c.z]],ix=[0,2,1,0,3,2,4,5,6,4,6,7,0,1,5,0,5,4,3,7,6,3,6,2,0,4,7,0,7,3,1,2,6,1,6,5],g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(new Float64Array(ix.flatMap(i=>p[i])),3));return g;}
export function buildDuixiuSideRelief(options){
 const b=buildDuixiuNaturalFront(options),[cx,cy,cz]=b.profile.center,cut=f(cy+BASE),removed=new Set(),regions=[],bases=[],pieces=[];
 for(const sign of[-1,1]){
  const outer=sign<0?9:9.25,inner=sign<0?7:6.75,front=f(cx+sign*outer),back=f(cx+sign*inner),r=new THREE.Box3(new THREE.Vector3(Math.min(front,back),-1e6,f(cz-4.5)),new THREE.Vector3(Math.max(front,back),1e6,f(cz+4.75))),cells=[],all=[];regions.push(r);
  for(const[i,g]of b.geometries.entries()){g.computeBoundingBox();const q=g.boundingBox,c={g,x0:q.min.x,x1:q.max.x,z0:q.min.z,z1:q.max.z,h:q.max.y,bottom:q.min.y};all.push(c);if(q.min.x>=r.min.x&&q.max.x<=r.max.x&&q.min.z>=r.min.z&&q.max.z<=r.max.z){removed.add(i);cells.push(c);}}
  const xs=[...new Set(cells.flatMap(c=>[c.x0,c.x1]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),zs=[...new Set(cells.flatMap(c=>[c.z0,c.z1]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b),grid=new Map();for(const c of cells){c.i=xs.indexOf(c.x0);c.j=zs.indexOf(c.z0);if(xs[c.i+1]!==c.x1||zs[c.j+1]!==c.z1)throw Error('Non-aligned source cells');grid.set(`${c.i},${c.j}`,c);}if(cells.length!==(xs.length-1)*(zs.length-1))throw Error('Incomplete source grid');for(let j=0;j<zs.length-1;j++)bases.push(buildDuixiuBaseUnion(cells.filter(c=>c.j===j),cut));
  const at=(i,j)=>grid.get(`${i},${j}`),border=(x,j,outward)=>{const candidates=all.filter(c=>c.z0<=zs[j]+1e-8&&c.z1>=zs[j]-1e-8&&Math.abs((outward?(sign<0?c.x1:c.x0):(sign<0?c.x0:c.x1))-x)<1e-7&&c.x1-c.x0<.3);if(!candidates.length)throw Error('Missing actual route-side boundary');return Math.min(...candidates.map(c=>c.h));};
  const rows=zs.map((z,j)=>{const low=border(front,j,true),high=border(back,j,false);return xs.map((x,i)=>{const t=(x-front)/(back-front),envelope=Math.sin(Math.PI*t),u=(z-cz),profile=t;let detail=0;for(const[a,b,w,amp]of[[-2.7,.3,1.1,1.15],[-.2,.64,1.5,-1.05],[2.4,.42,1.25,1.2],[3.7,.8,.9,-.9]])detail+=Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(u-a-.5*t)/w)*Math.max(0,1-Math.abs(t-b)/.24)*amp;const incident=[at(i-1,j-1),at(i,j-1),at(i-1,j),at(i,j)].filter(Boolean),ceiling=Math.min(...incident.map(c=>c.h));const endFade=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(z-zs[0])/.9,(zs.at(-1)-z)/.9)),natural=low+(high-low)*profile+detail*envelope,y=Math.min(ceiling,ceiling*(1-endFade)+natural*endFade);return new THREE.Vector3(x,f(Math.max(cut+.1,y)),z);});});
  for(let first=0;first<zs.length-1;first+=6){const end=Math.min(zs.length-1,first+6),pos=[],normal=[],uv=[],color=[],id=`duixiu:side-relief:${sign}:${first}`;
   const tri=(a,b,c,want)=>{let n=b.clone().sub(a).cross(c.clone().sub(a));if(n.lengthSq()<1e-18)return;if(n.dot(want)<0){[b,c]=[c,b];n.negate();}n.normalize();for(const p of[a,b,c]){pos.push(...p.toArray());normal.push(...n.toArray());uv.push(p.z/3,p.y/3);const v=.69+.02*Math.sin(p.y*.6+p.z*.4);color.push(v,v*.985,v*.94);}};
   for(let j=first;j<end;j++)for(let i=0;i<xs.length-1;i++){const a=rows[j][i],bb=rows[j][i+1],c=rows[j+1][i+1],d=rows[j+1][i];if((i+j)%2){tri(a,bb,d,new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0));tri(bb,c,d,new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0));}else{tri(a,bb,c,new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0));tri(a,c,d,new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0));}}
   const edge=[...rows[first],...rows.slice(first+1,end+1).map(r=>r.at(-1)),...rows[end].slice(0,-1).reverse(),...rows.slice(first+1,end).reverse().map(r=>r[0])],origin=new THREE.Vector3(f((xs[0]+xs.at(-1))/2),cut,f((zs[first]+zs[end])/2));
   for(let i=0;i<edge.length;i++){const a=edge[i],bb=edge[(i+1)%edge.length],ba=new THREE.Vector3(a.x,cut,a.z),bc=new THREE.Vector3(bb.x,cut,bb.z),want=new THREE.Vector3(bb.z-a.z,0,a.x-bb.x);tri(ba,bc,bb,want);tri(ba,bb,a,want);tri(origin,bc,ba,new THREE.Vector3(0,-1,0));}
   const g=new THREE.BufferGeometry();g.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pos,3));g.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normal,3));g.setAttribute('uv',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(uv,2));g.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(color,3));faceTriplanarUV(g,3);g.userData.naturalOwner=id;pieces.push({id,g,boundaryWorld:edge.map(p=>p.toArray()),sourceCells:cells.filter(c=>c.j>=first&&c.j<end).map(({x0,x1,z0,z1,h,bottom})=>({x0,x1,z0,z1,h,bottom}))});
  }
 }
 const owner=(g,id)=>{const s=triangleInstance(createTriangleTemplate(g),[0,0,0],id),box=s.box.clone();box.triangleSupport=s;box.duixiuTerrain=true;return box;};let part=0;b.geometries=b.geometries.filter((g,i)=>{if(removed.has(i)){g.dispose();return false;}return true;});for(const r of regions)b.colliders=b.colliders.flatMap(c=>outside(c,r).map(q=>{if(q===c)return c;const g=boxGeometry(q),o=owner(g,`duixiu:relief-retain:${part++}`);g.dispose();return o;}));for(const[i,g]of bases.entries()){g.userData.retainedRouteBase=true;b.geometries.push(g);b.colliders.push(owner(g,`duixiu:relief-base:${i}`));}const rocks=[];for(const{g,...meta}of pieces){b.geometries.push(g);b.colliders.push(owner(g,meta.id));rocks.push(meta);}b.profile={...b.profile,sideRelief:{status:'CONTROLLED_NONPATH_RELIEF',baseUnion:'EXACT_SOURCE_ROW_UNION',baseOwners:bases.length,regions:regions.map(r=>({min:r.min.toArray(),max:r.max.toArray()})),rocks,removedGeometry:removed.size}};return b;
}
